overrides.reason: ZGEES hands its LWORK to ZGEHRD, ZUNGHR and ZHSEQR, which pick their block size or AED window from LWORK. The blocked and unblocked Hessenberg reductions round differently, and the QR iteration that follows reaches a Schur form T that is unique only up to unit phases (and, past the reference's crossover, the eigenvalue order), with Schur vectors transformed to match. The reference does this as well: compiled LAPACK 3.12.0 ZGEES at N = 150 (random matrix, JOBVS = 'V') returns a different A, VS and order of W at LWORK = 2N than at its queried optimum. The JS zgehrd crosses over at NX = 32 where ILAENV(3) gives 128, so the JS path changes from N > 33 (the reference's from N > 128). The module's tests check the eigenvalues, SDIM and A = Z*T*Z^H at the minimum WORK past the blocking threshold (ticket 0100).

set.params.A.workDependent: the Schur form T is unique only up to unit phases, which the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change
set.params.VS.workDependent: the Schur vectors are unique only up to the same unit phases as T, which the LWORK-dependent Hessenberg blocking can change
